liveNearbyHint: A window opens in the app of the person you invite; when they press Join, the document opens for them. The document stays with you; they keep nothing once sharing ends. When you give the pen to someone who "Can edit in turn", what they write goes into your document.

liveHubCodePrompt: Type the code you were sent:

liveBusyConnecting: Another connection is being set up right now.
liveHostUnverified: The inviting device could not be verified.
